title: Photosynthesis: data question set (20 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 52 (Photosynthesis data question set (20 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Answer every question. Show working and units for calculations. Mark it with the mark scheme.

questions.q: Write the word equation for photosynthesis.
questions.a: Carbon dioxide + water → glucose + oxygen (light energy, chlorophyll) (2)

questions.q: Name the green substance that absorbs light.
A pondweed gives off 8 bubbles a minute at 40 cm from a lamp, 15 at 20 cm and 30 at 10 cm. Describe the pattern.
questions.a: The closer the lamp, the more bubbles (1): rate of photosynthesis increases with light intensity (1)

questions.q: Name the gas in the bubbles.
Give two variables that must be controlled in the pondweed experiment.
questions.a: Temperature, carbon dioxide (amount of bicarbonate), same piece of pondweed, time (any two)

questions.q: Explain why the rate stops increasing at very high light intensity.
questions.a: Another factor becomes limiting (1), such as carbon dioxide or temperature (1)

questions.q: Describe how to test a leaf for starch.
questions.a: Boil in water to kill it (1); warm in ethanol (in a water bath) to remove chlorophyll (1); rinse and add iodine (1); blue-black shows starch (1)

questions.q: A variegated leaf has green and white parts. After the starch test, only the green parts turn blue-black. Explain why.
questions.a: Only green parts have chlorophyll (1), so only they photosynthesise and make starch (1)

questions.q: Give two ways a plant uses the glucose it makes.
questions.a: Respiration; stored as starch; making cellulose for cell walls; making proteins (any two)
They make their own food (glucose) using light energy
